coverage.definition: Unchecked is not unavailable; absence from one response is not a deletion signal.

observations.notice: Gap between our observations, not source change time. Samples are not a market-wide random sample.

studies.notice: Endpoint comparisons can miss intervening changes. Pairs overlap and are not independent market samples.

calibration.confidence: LOW: completed classes are not a random sample; alternative is sensitivity analysis, not a confidence interval.
